title: US equity markets closed — Birthday of Martin Luther King, Jr. (the Monday that shortens January 2028 expiration week to four sessions)
source: NEWS: nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars (redirects to nyse.com/trade/hours-calendars, HTTP 200, 109,180 bytes, re-fetched direct 2026-09-09 with a browser User-Agent by the initial-research session that wrote this canonical file). Its 'Holidays & Trading Hours' table is headed 'All NYSE markets observe U.S. holidays as listed below for 2026, 2027, and 2028' and carries the row verbatim in the page's embedded JSON cell payload: 'Martin Luther King, Jr. Day' | 'Monday, January 19' | 'Monday, January 18' | 'Monday, January 17' — i.e. 2028-01-17. CORROBORATED BY A SECOND PRIMARY RE-FETCHED THE SAME SESSION: federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/k8.htm (HTTP 200, 82,205 bytes, 'K.8 - Holidays Observed by the Federal Reserve System 2026-2030', page stamped Last Update: July 8, 2026), whose 'Birthday of Martin Luther King, Jr.' row reads January 19 / January 18 / January 17 / January 15 / January 21 across 2026-2030, giving January 17 for 2028. Reproduced independently by statute: 5 U.S.C. 6103 fixes the holiday on the THIRD MONDAY IN JANUARY, and January 2028's Mondays are the 3rd, 10th, 17th, 24th and 31st (2028-01-01 is a Saturday, itself corroborated on both primaries — NYSE's 2028 New Year's cell reads '—*' under the footnote 'Because the holiday falls on Saturday, January 1, 2028, no New Year's Day holiday is observed', and K.8's 2028 New Year's row reads 'January 1*'). WHY STILL ESTIMATE, and it is not doubt about the date: market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for an exchange holiday calendar, and the one route it does allow — `OCC:` (theocc.com / Cboe) — is unavailable, because cboe.com/about/hours/us-options/ was re-fetched this same session (HTTP 200, 386,116 bytes) and carries ONLY a '2026 Options Holiday Schedule', no 2027 table and no 2028 table. All 37 closure-class entries in this calendar sit at `estimate` for exactly this reason. PROMOTION CRITERION: an exchange-calendar prefix being added to the taxonomy, or Cboe publishing a 2028 options holiday schedule listing 2028-01-17 under the existing `OCC:` prefix. Proposed by the fomc-blackout-start-2028-01-15 adjacency sweep 2026-09-09; canonical file written by the mlk-market-closure-2028-01-17 initial research the same day
notes: CANONICAL FILE written by this event's own `never-assessed` initial research (2026-09-09), after reading its single proposal, proposals/mlk-market-closure-2028-01-17.from-fomc-blackout-start-2028-01-15.json, which stays where it is and is now shadowed. EventKind has no member for an exchange-schedule event, so 'sector' is the least-wrong option rather than a right one — inherited from the mlk-market-closure-2027-01-18 / good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26 / presidents-day-market-closure-2027-02-15 class. THE STRUCTURAL FACT THAT DISTINGUISHES 2028 FROM THE 2027 SIBLING, computed 1998-2050 by this session and reproducing the sibling's own figures independently: MLK's spacing to January expiration is binary, and 2028 draws the MINORITY side — MLK 2028-01-17 is January expiration (2028-01-21) MINUS FOUR, the 22/53 (41.5%) configuration, where 2027 drew the 31/53 (58.5%) +3 side. So MLK 2028 deletes the MONDAY OF EXPIRATION WEEK rather than the first post-expiration session, and January 2028 expiration week runs four sessions (01-18, 01-19, 01-20, 01-21). Only three US closures can ever do this to any month: across all 636 expiration weeks 1998-2050, exactly 53 (8.33%) are shortened to four sessions, by Washington's Birthday (23), MLK (22) and Juneteenth (8) and nothing else. SECOND STRUCTURAL FACT, the one the parent could not see: 2028-01-01 falling on a Saturday means NYSE observes NO New Year's holiday in 2028, so January 2028 carries exactly ONE market closure — and that same fact is what forces the -4 spacing. All 8 of the 53 years with a Saturday January 1 (2000, 2005, 2011, 2022, 2028, 2033, 2039, 2050) are -4 years; one cause, two consequences. THE 2027 SIBLING'S VIX-STRIP FINDING DOES NOT TRANSFER: consecutive third Fridays 2028-01-21 -> 2028-02-18 are 28 days apart, so the strips OVERLAP by two days (2028-01-19 -> 01-21) instead of leaving a hole, and MLK 2028-01-17 sits INSIDE the December-2027 contract's 30-day window. Impact LOW and structural: a closed session moves nothing by itself, and trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md were re-grepped this session for holiday|mlk|martin luther|closure|three-day weekend|half-day|early close|shortened week|expiration week with ZERO hits in both. BOND SIDE STILL UNSTATED, now with a dated fetch proving the absence rather than an unread panel: sifma.org/resources/general/holiday-schedule/ (HTTP 200, 299,159 bytes, 2026-09-09) publishes 2026 and 2027 US recommendations only; its calendar terminates at 'New Year's Day 2027/2028 | Saturday, January 1, 2028' and carries no 2028 MLK entry. Proposed as an estimate; estimates widen caution only and nothing here licenses an entry.
